title: MorseEEG-ATP
description: MorseEEG-ATP is a multitask EEG dataset for studying auditory temporal processing and temporal pattern discrimination using Morse code stimuli. It contains synchronized 62-channel EEG and behavioral data from 32 healthy adults performing dot-count and first-last match discrimination tasks at three presentation rates (15, 30, and 40 characters per minute). The release includes raw and minimally preprocessed EEG, event annotations, behavioral measures, and analysis scripts in an EEG-BIDS structure.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.tec g.HIamp system at 600 Hz from 62 scalp electrodes (10-20 system) referenced to the right earlobe, with online 0.1-100 Hz bandpass and 48-52 Hz notch filtering. Stimuli and behavioral responses were controlled with E-Prime 3.0. Each trial comprised a fixation period, stimulus presentation, response window, and jittered inter-trial interval.
